description.quote: The central detector of UA1 was a six-chambered cylinder, 5.8 metres long and 2.3 metres in diameter.
description.value: Six-chambered cylinder 5.8 m long and 2.3 m in diameter; the largest imaging drift chamber of its day.
An 800-tonne conventional electromagnet surrounding the central detector.

summary.plain: A house-sized detector wrapped around the SPS beam pipe, with a giant electronic 'camera' (a drift chamber) at its heart to photograph particle tracks from each collision.
summary.technical: General-purpose (4-pi) collider detector: central six-chambered imaging drift chamber (5.8 m long, 2.3 m diameter) inside an 800-tonne conventional dipole magnet, 48 lead-layer ('gondola') electromagnetic subdetectors, hadron calorimetry and muon chambers requiring about 30 km of extruded aluminium.

technology.quote: A 4-pi Solid Angle Detector for the SPS Used as a pp-bar Collider at a c.m. Energy of 630 GeV
technology.value: General-purpose (4-pi) collider detector with a central imaging drift chamber, electromagnetic and hadronic calorimetry and muon chambers around a conventional dipole magnet
